decision.observation: The inspected ceiling deposit is 179.9 kg Oxylite, currently emitting 54.7 g/s Oxygen—not Dirt. The completed Outhouse still needs 200 kg Dirt, and a food-source warning has appeared.
decision.hypothesis: The brown deposit above the Oxylite may be Dirt; identifying it could provide a nearby source for the Outhouse.
decision.memory: The Outhouse is built and publicly assigned but needs 200 kg Dirt. An Oxylite deposit above the base is passively emitting Oxygen. The Oxygen Diffuser still needs Metal Ore and power; keep the left reservoir sealed.
